sloka: सा तु तद्वचनं श्रुत्वा कन्यका पितृगौरवात् ।तत्रोपागम्य सा तस्थौ विश्रवा यत्र तप्यते ।। ७.९.१३ ॥
transliteration: sā tu tadvacanaṁ śrutvā kanyakā pitṛgauravāt ।tatropāgamya sā tasthau viśravā yatra tapyate ।। 7.9.13 ॥

translations.english: Having heard that instruction, the maiden, out of respect for her father, approached the place where Vishravas was performing penance and stood there.
